      result=1; stage=cleanup-database
    fi
  fi

    if ! printf '\''{"complete":true,"isolatedDatabaseRemoved":true}\n'\'' > "$backup_dir/completion.json"; then
      printf '\''MEMORY_BACKUP_FAILED_STAGE=completion-evidence\n'\''; exit 1
    fi

      printf '\''MEMORY_BACKUP_FAILED_STAGE=completion-evidence\n'\''; exit 1
    fi
    printf '\''MEMORY_BACKUP_RECEIPT='\''; cat "$backup_dir/verification.json"
    printf '\''MEMORY_BACKUP_COMPLETE=1\n'\''
  else
    printf '\''MEMORY_BACKUP_FAILED_STAGE=%s\n'\'' "$stage"; result=1
  fi
  exit "$result"
}
